Container.Name: laminator
Container.Overview: laminator draws MDBList score badges (IMDb, TMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and more) on the posters in your Emby and Jellyfin libraries, and can change metadata such as content rating, titles and descriptions, all from one web UI. Every change is reversible.
Container.Description:
laminator is an alternative to Kometa's overlays for Emby and Jellyfin, supported equally. It draws score badges on your existing posters and applies metadata overrides to your items, and it can undo everything it did.
Key Features: - Score badges from MDBList (the combined score, or IMDb, TMDb, Trakt, Letterboxd, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and others), always drawn on the untouched original so they update instead of stacking. - Templates with a live preview, to design the badge: position, size, font and which sources to show. - Metadata overrides: content rating, title, sort title, original title, tagline, description, critic rating, tags, genres and more, locked so a library refresh cannot undo them. - Custom posters per title, for fan edits and the like, with a searchable gallery. - Copies of one title (an HD and a UHD folder) shown together, each still with its own poster if you want. - Fully reversible: original posters and old values are kept, restorable per title or all at once. - Scheduled runs that only touch new or changed posters, backups to a folder of your choice with an optional second copy, and a library page with filters, search and posters, compact or list views. - Emby and Jellyfin side by side, each with its own saved posters. - Secure web UI: password chosen on first start, optional two-factor sign-in, ready for a reverse proxy.
After the first start, open the container's log for the one-time setup code, open the WebUI, choose a password, then add your media server and your MDBList key in Settings. laminator changes posters and metadata on your media server, so try it on a few titles first and read the README's disclaimer. Keep the /data folder in your backups: it holds the saved original posters.
Container.Requires: An Emby or Jellyfin server and a free MDBList API key from mdblist.com.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: emby jellyfin posters overlay badges ratings scores mdblist metadata kometa artwork

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings, saved original posters and state (and the backups, unless you map a Backup Folder below). Keep this in your backups.

Config.Name: Custom Posters Folder
Config.Description: Optional: a folder for your own base posters (Settings > Custom posters > folder: /assets).

Config.Name: Backup Folder
Config.Description: Optional: keep laminator's backups here instead of inside App Data, for example on the array or another share. Also set Backup Folder Path below to /backups (or choose it in Settings > Backup and restore > Backup folder, which can move existing backups for you).

Config.Name: Backup Folder Path
Config.Description: Optional: /backups to use the Backup Folder mapped above. Leave empty to keep backups in App Data (a folder chosen in Settings takes precedence).

Config.Name: Second Backup Folder
Config.Description: Optional: a second copy of every backup, for example on another disk or share. Turn it on in Settings > Backup and restore > Second copy: Local folder, path /backups-secondary.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, for the schedule (for example America/New_York).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional: preset the web UI password instead of choosing it on first start with the setup code from the log.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional, behind a reverse proxy: the address you use in the browser, for example https://laminator.example.com.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Optional, behind a reverse proxy: the proxy's address or network (for example 172.18.0.0/16). Only its forwarded headers are believed.
